name: Assisted Suicide
overview: Scripture firmly upholds the sanctity of life, commanding 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13) and warning against actions that bring about untimely death (Ecclesiastes 7:17). While life has appointed seasons and purposes (Ecclesiastes 3:1), believers are called to trust God’s timing and sovereignty, as seen in Job’s response to suffering through worship rather than despair (Job 1:20). The Lord hears the cries of the righteous and delivers them from troubles (Psalms 34:17), contrasting with His abhorrence of deceitful and bloodthirsty behavior (Psalms 5:6), which includes taking life prematurely. Thus, assisted suicide contradicts the biblical call to honor life as a sacred gift from God.
